posts.name: ChangingWay
posts.cooked:
Yes, thank to >G, and to Pydro for starting this thread. I was taught SotM a few months ago, and since then my 7yo son and I have had great fun with it. The game itself is clearly a labor or love, and we love it.

I'm looking forward to my RRR (Rook city + infernal Relics Reprint) + promos + a couple of other things order. I think that >G is being admirably flexible right now. You want both expansions in one box, cheaper than buying them separately would be? (Yes, of course I do!) You got it. You want just one of the expansions, no box, since you've already got the other? You got it. Oh, you just want the box? You got it. And you get promos too. 

I'm sure that there will be complaints from people who were hibernating in December, and so miss some of this but I don't think it's reasonable to expect you to be this flexible indefinitely. 

Andrew, with best wishes for 2014 to all at >G, and all in this community.
